terminal_basis.label: CALCULATED
terminal_basis.note: Re-derived from the corrected evidence, not preserved from the reviewed head. On the tested substrate: the capacity role is decisively positive on measured memory-fit facts (106.5x); the matched genuinely-concurrent coarse shape is negative (0.55x aggregate, cold-start retained); the single-sequence layer split is throughput-positive only from the weaker anchor's perspective (1.26x) and negative from the stronger (0.62x); the finer row-split shape is unsupported. The envelope as a whole: an added x1 participant is reliably useful for capacity/residency, conditionally useful as a single-sequence compute partner when the anchor is the weaker device, and not useful for concurrent coarse serving on this substrate.
